own_solution.law: Snell's law at the entry face; zigzag path L/cos r; t = n L / (c cos r)
assumptions: TIR at sides holds (69.1 deg > 33.7 deg critical)

notes: All certified answers verified: base 1.8*2/(3e8*0.934065) = 12.8471 ns; L+q = 2.7, 3.3, 4.2 m give 17.3436, 21.1977, 26.9789 ns. Diameter cancellation expression reduces to nL/(c cos r). Minimal pairs T507D/T2524 and TE2F0/TB902 share 1.3 m and differ only in attachment/timing. My pass-1 low rendering_not_minimal flag on T97AD and TACC7 is withdrawn: the authors declare them numeral-free controls by design (twins of T507D and TE2F0), not number-bearing variants. Strata agree with my pass 1 throughout.
